title: Remainder check
prompt: Implement `boolean dividesEvenly(int a, int b)`: true when `b` divides `a` with no remainder. Careful with `b == 0`: division by zero never happens because `&&` short-circuits — return false when `b` is 0.

tests.name: remainder logic
tests.hint: b != 0 && a % b == 0 — the guard runs first and short-circuits.
